items.title: Jev 1.14.0 Release
items.summary: Jev 1.14.0 is now available, with experimental features like images, a new question type, and longer context.

items.title: $1.5B Series E Funding
items.summary: Tenstorrent closes $1.5B Series E at a $6.2B valuation, funding volume manufacturing and global expansion.

items.title: Acquisition of Loops
items.summary: Salesforce acquires Loops, an AI-powered analytics platform, to enhance its AI CRM capabilities.

items.title: AI Funding Roundup
items.summary: AI funding reached $2.42B in October 12-18, 2026, with Modal's $750M Series D being the largest round.

items.title: Gemini 4 Argon Release
items.summary: Gemini 4 Argon is now available for developers, designed for complex coding, agentic, math, and science tasks.

items.title: Gemini 4 Argon App Availability
items.summary: Gemini 4 Argon is now available in the Gemini app, delivering improved performance across complex tasks.

items.title: Jev 1.14.0 Release
items.summary: TypeSafe AI released Jev 1.14.0, featuring images, a new Box question type, and 262k context.

items.title: Clef Models Availability
items.summary: Cloudflare's Clef models are now available on Workers AI, offering decision-making capabilities through typed questions.

items.title: Latent Abstraction for RAG
items.summary: A paper proposes Latent Abstraction for Retrieval-Augmented Generation, aiming to improve RAG systems with better query generation.

items.title: Mercury 3 Availability
items.summary: Mercury 3 is now available on AI Gateway with 50% off launch pricing and improved reasoning for latency-sensitive workloads.

items.title: Suki Raises $90M Series E
items.summary: Suki has raised $90M Series E to scale healthcare AI agents for health systems and health tech companies.

items.title: Rocket Software Acquires Geniez AI
items.summary: Rocket Software has acquired Geniez AI to accelerate agentic AI for mainframe modernization.

items.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Begins
items.summary: The European Commission starts enforcing AI Act rules and new transparency requirements from 2 August.

items.title: Nebius Signs with VOLT's Rotterdam AI Gigafactory
items.summary: Nebius has signed as the first customer for VOLT's €7 billion Rotterdam AI Gigafactory, securing 100,000 GPUs.

items.title: LiteRAG Paper Published
items.summary: LiteRAG: Cost-Efficient Graph-Based Retrieval-Augmented Generation is a new paper introducing a graph-based RAG method.

items.title: Claude Haiku 5.5 Availability
items.summary: Claude Haiku 5.5 is now available for high-volume, cost-sensitive tasks, with improved speed and efficiency for subagent tasks.

items.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 Release
items.summary: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 is now available on AI Gateway, with improvements in reasoning, coding, and image understanding.

items.title: MCP Spec TPM Updates
items.summary: New SEPs are being proposed for the MCP specification, including the formation of the Tasks and Events Working Group.

items.title: Gemini 4 Argon Release
items.summary: Gemini 4 Argon is now available for developers, built for long-horizon workflows requiring deep reasoning and structural precision.

items.title: Jev 1.14.0 Release
items.summary: Jev 1.14.0 introduces experimental features like images, a new type, and longer context, available via the AI Gateway.

items.title: GPT-Live Voices
items.summary: Nine new natural voices for GPT-Live were added, including Nuri, Juni, and Flitz (German), Brise and Sillage (French), and others.

items.title: Jev 1.14.0 Release
items.summary: Jev 1.14.0 is now available, with experimental features like images, a Box type, and 262k context, accessible via danger-zone headers.

items.title: Claude Haiku 5.5 Availability
items.summary: Claude Haiku 5.5 is now available, designed for high-volume, cost-sensitive tasks and pairs well with Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 as a subagent.

items.title: Prompt-to-Voice Feature
items.summary: Prompt-to-voice feature released for all API customers, allowing creation of custom voices through the API or voice Playground.

items.title: Ultrafast for GPT-6.1 Sol
items.summary: Ultrafast mode for GPT-6.1 Sol is now available, offering up to 8x faster speeds than standard, ideal for rapid development workflows.

items.title: Prompt-to-Voice Feature
items.summary: Prompt-to-voice is now available for all API customers, allowing custom voice creation from text descriptions.

items.title: Jev 1.14.0 Release
items.summary: Jev 1.14.0 is now available, featuring experimental features like images and longer context, available behind danger-zone headers.

items.title: Clef-omni Availability
items.summary: Clef-omni, a decision model that supports audio and video input, is now available on Workers AI.

items.title: Claude Haiku 5.5 Availability
items.summary: Claude Haiku 5.5 is now available on AWS, optimized for speed and cost-sensitive tasks.

items.title: MCP Specification Update
items.summary: The MCP specification was updated to remove protocol-level sessions and introduce cacheable list results.

items.title: Jev 1.14 preview — and jev-latest moves around Oct 21
items.summary: Out under the jev-preview alias at 1.13 prices. Anything sending jev-latest or relying on the SDK default switches automatically in about a week, so pin jev-1.13.0 if you want to choose your own moment.

items.title: TypeSafe raises $870M Series A at $7.5B, 24 days after launch
items.summary: Led by Andreessen Horowitz with Sequoia and seed investor DCVC; Martin Casado joins the board. The seed was $40M — a roughly 20x step in under a month, on a model that cannot write a sentence.

items.title: Muse Glimmer: a 30B agent model under Apache 2.0
items.summary: Distilled from Meta's closed Muse Spark and sized to run agent workflows on one consumer GPU — ~29.6B dense, 131k context, controllable reasoning effort, with 24GB and 32GB quantizations. Reverses the closed turn Muse Spark took in April.

items.title: EU AI Act: Commission gains GPAI enforcement powers
items.summary: The obligations applied from August 2025; what started now is enforcement. The Commission can demand documentation, run its own evaluations, and restrict, withdraw or recall a model, with fines to 3% of worldwide turnover or EUR 15M. Models released before Aug 2 2025 have until Aug 2 2027.

items.title: AMD to buy World Labs for about $8.2B in stock
items.summary: Fei-Fei Li's spatial-intelligence startup, in an all-stock deal expected to close by end of 2026 subject to regulatory approval. Reported figure, not a filing.

items.title: OpenTelemetry export for Messages and Managed Agents
items.summary: Beta. The Python, TypeScript, C#, Go, Java, PHP and Ruby SDKs emit spans for Messages API requests and Managed Agents sessions, so traces land in whatever collector you already run instead of a vendor console.

items.title: Gemini 4 Argon GA
items.summary: First of the Gemini 4 line to reach general availability, aimed at complex coding, agentic work, maths and science.

items.title: Jev: a model that decides instead of writing
items.summary: TypeSafe AI's first 'System One' model returns a typed choice, score or boolean with a calibrated confidence, never text. Constrained output means it can't break your schema — but it can be confident and still pick the wrong valid option.

items.title: Computer use leaves beta; browser use ships
items.summary: computer_toolset_20260801 adds batch actions and default zoom. The new browser_toolset_20260801 drives a browser your app hosts, reading the accessibility tree instead of screenshots alone.

items.title: GPT-5.6 Sol cut over 20% for three months
items.summary: API and credit pricing only, and explicitly temporary. Worth testing against, not worth rebuilding routing economics around.

items.title: Assistants API removed
items.summary: One year after notice, the endpoint is gone; Responses plus Conversations is the path. Older GPT-5 and o3 snapshots follow on December 11.

items.title: MCP 2026-07-28 final: the protocol goes stateless
items.summary: No Mcp-Session-Id, no initialize handshake, tools/list cacheable via ttlMs, cross-call state as server-minted handles. Roots, Sampling and Logging deprecated on a 12-month floor.

items.title: VISTA: agents as their own context managers
items.summary: Training-free, model-agnostic layer giving typed, addressable context blocks with archival and recovery. Drops over an existing agent loop.

items.title: TokenPilot: compaction that keeps the prefix cache
items.summary: Cache-efficient context management. Read it if you suspect your compaction step is quietly destroying cache hit rate.

items.title: SmoothAgent: lookahead context engineering for serving
items.summary: Aimed at latency rather than accuracy, which is a rare framing. The closest of the three to observability work.

items.title: Jalapeño inference chip — announced, not available
items.summary: Throughput, latency and power claims are sourced only to OpenAI, and the chip is in deployment planning. Nothing here changes what you can ship.
